div.div:
▬▬ Cat6 / physical link - - - management (telnet / SSH) ▬▬ A/V control (adb, HDMI, CEC)
- - - cloud egress - - - Wi-Fi / DHCP
Invariants worth keeping in mind
• One L3 subnet, zero routed hops — latency differences are L2 switch hops only.
• All hub logic is ucode (.uc); /bin/sh only wraps ping / adb / nc.
• Central dashboard is hosted on JioRouter AX6000 (.50); TP-Link (.12) 302-redirects to it.
• CGI never touches a device synchronously — pollers own all device I/O, CGI reads /tmp.
• Huawei APs accept exactly one telnet session; the poller holds it most of the time.
• Mi TV adb is single-authorised: drive it from the router only.
